 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chetan Bhagat** is the author of the book 'Revolution 2020'.
 
• Chetan Bhagat is a well-known Indian author who has written several popular novels, including 'Five Point Someone', '2 States', and 'The 3 Mistakes of My Life'.
 
• 'Revolution 2020' is a novel that explores themes of love, corruption, and ambition in contemporary India.
 
• The book was published in 2011 and has since been widely read and appreciated for its engaging storytelling and relatable characters.

• **Chetan Bhagat** is also known for his work as a columnist and motivational speaker.
 
• He has received several awards for his contributions to literature and has been recognized as one of the most influential people in India.
 
• Many of his books have been adapted into successful Bollywood films, further increasing his popularity among readers and moviegoers alike.
 
• Bhagat's writing style is often praised for its simplicity and ability to connect with the youth of India.
